libm.why: The one transcendental implementation the ops module calls: pure Rust, the same bits on arm64, x86_64 and wasm32.

serde.why: Derives the document model's serialization; it moves values and computes nothing from them. A facade over serde_core.

serde_core.why: The traits and impls serde re-exports; moves values, computes nothing from them.

serde_derive.why: The proc macro behind serde's derives: runs in the compiler and ships no code of its own; the code it generates calls serde_core.

proc-macro2.why: Token handling for serde_derive; runs in the compiler only.

quote.why: Token quoting for serde_derive; runs in the compiler only.

syn.why: Rust parsing for serde_derive; runs in the compiler only.

unicode-ident.why: Identifier tables for proc-macro2; runs in the compiler only.

serde_json.why: Parses and prints documents; its float formatting is shortest-round-trip (exact), and a check reads the parsed values, never the text's layout.

zmij.why: serde_json's float printer: the shortest text that reads back to the same f64, exact by construction; a check never reads the text.

itoa.why: serde_json's integer printer; a check never reads the text.

memchr.why: Byte search in serde_json's parser; integer code only.

indexmap.why: The insertion-ordered map behind serde_json's preserve_order: iteration follows insertion, never a hash; integer code only.

equivalent.why: Key-equivalence traits indexmap uses; no computation.

hashbrown.why: The table indexmap holds its indices in; indexmap never iterates it in hash order; integer code only.

foldhash.why: hashbrown's hasher as indexmap uses it, for lookups only; integer mixing, and no order a check reads comes from it.

allocator-api2.why: Allocator traits hashbrown is generic over; no computation.

sha2.why: Integer-only hashing for digests and hash@1 keys; the same bits everywhere by construction.

digest.why: The hashing traits sha2 implements; integer code only.

block-buffer.why: The input block buffer sha2 fills; integer code only.

crypto-common.why: Shared trait definitions for digest; no computation.

generic-array.why: Fixed-size arrays typed by length, for digest outputs; no computation.

typenum.why: Type-level integers for generic-array; resolved at compile time.

subtle.why: Constant-time equality for digest outputs; integer code only.

cpufeatures.why: Detects CPU features once so sha2 picks an accelerated path; every path gives the digest SHA-2 specifies, so the choice never reaches a check.

libc.why: The FFI bindings cpufeatures reads the feature flags through; nothing a check reads.

cfg-if.why: A compile-time cfg macro sha2 and cpufeatures use; no code of its own at run time.

unicode-normalization.why: Table-driven NFC for the canonical form of names; integer and string code only.

tinyvec.why: The small vector unicode-normalization buffers code points in; integer code only.

taffy.why: Auto layout's engine (#375), as GPUI's: flexbox and grid in plain f32 add, multiply, divide, min, max and round, which IEEE 754 makes the same bits everywhere; no libm call, no SIMD, #![deny(unsafe_code)]; its HashMap alias is unused, and its clock is behind the debug and profile features, which aren't on.

slotmap.why: Taffy's node storage, keyed by generational index; iterated by slot, never by hash; integer code only.

arrayvec.why: Fixed-capacity vectors for taffy and kurbo; integer code only.

smallvec.why: Inline vectors for taffy's grid tracks and fontique; integer code only.

parley.why: The canvas's one shaper (#390), whose advances and line heights size text leaves (#375): it sums HarfRust's advances and the line metrics in f32 add and multiply, no libm; its one hash map is a style set keyed by property kind, each kind held once, so its order never reaches a result.

parley_engine.why: parley's line breaking and layout: UAX #14 breaks from icu_segmenter and line metrics in f32 add and multiply; no libm call.

parley_data.why: parley's baked Unicode property tables; data only.

parley_emoji.why: parley's emoji sequence tables; data only.

parlance.why: Script and language tags parley and fontique share; integer and string code only.

fontique.why: parley's font collection; deep-text gives it the bundled fonts only (no system fonts), and families resolve by name: its hash maps are looked up, and where one is iterated (merging registered families) each family ID is written once, so the order never reaches a size.

linebender_resource_handle.why: The shared font-blob handle parley, fontique and peniko pass; no computation.

memmap2.why: fontique's loader for font files on disk; deep-text loads bundled bytes only, so it's linked and never called.

harfrust.why: parley's shaper: glyph selection and advances in integer font units, scaled to the size by one f32 multiply; no libm call.

skrifa.why: Font metrics and outlines for parley and the atlas. Metrics are integer font units scaled by an f32 multiply; its libm calls (sqrt, hypot, sin, cos, tan) are in the hinter, glyf outlines and color-glyph transforms, which feed drawn pixels, never a size a check reads.

read-fonts.why: skrifa's table parser: integer and fixed-point reads; its sin_cos and tan are in variable-composite outline transforms, drawn only.

font-types.why: Font fixed-point and tag types; conversions to f32 are exact (a shift and a scale by a power of two).

bytemuck.why: Plain-data casts for read-fonts and the rasterizer; no arithmetic.

bytemuck_derive.why: bytemuck's derive macros; run in the compiler only.

bitflags.why: Flag sets in harfrust; integer code only.

icu_segmenter.why: UAX #14 line breaks for parley, rule- and dictionary-based; its LSTM model (exp, tanh) is behind the lstm feature, which isn't on.

icu_segmenter_data.why: icu_segmenter's baked break rules; data only.

icu_properties.why: Unicode properties for parley's analysis; table lookups only.

icu_normalizer.why: Unicode normalization for parley's cluster analysis; integer code only.

icu_collections.why: The code point tries ICU's tables use; integer code only.

icu_locale_core.why: Locale identifiers for the segmenter; string code only.

icu_locale_fallback.why: Locale fallback chains for ICU data; string code only.

icu_provider.why: ICU's data loading traits, over the baked data; no computation.

litemap.why: A sorted-vector map in ICU's locale types; iterated in key order; integer code only.

tinystr.why: Small ASCII strings for ICU's locale tags; integer code only.

writeable.why: ICU's string writer trait; string code only.

potential_utf.why: UTF types in ICU's tries; integer code only.

utf8_iter.why: UTF-8 decoding for icu_collections; integer code only.

zerotrie.why: Byte tries for ICU's data keys; looked up, never iterated in hash order; integer code only.

zerovec.why: Zero-copy vectors over ICU's baked data; integer code only.

zerovec-derive.why: zerovec's derive macros; run in the compiler only.

yoke.why: Borrowed-data carriers for ICU's data; no computation.

yoke-derive.why: yoke's derive macro; runs in the compiler only.

zerofrom.why: Zero-copy conversion traits for ICU's data; no computation.

zerofrom-derive.why: zerofrom's derive macro; runs in the compiler only.

stable_deref_trait.why: A marker trait yoke requires; no code.

synstructure.why: Derive helpers for yoke-derive and zerofrom-derive; run in the compiler only.

displaydoc.why: ICU's Display derive; runs in the compiler only.

thiserror.why: Error types in vello_common; no computation.

thiserror-impl.why: thiserror's derive; runs in the compiler only.

once_cell.why: Lazy statics in read-fonts; no computation.

log.why: Logging macros in glifo; nothing logged is read by a check.

vello_cpu.why: Rasterizes the atlas's glyphs (#390): pixels drawn, never a size or position a check reads; deep-text runs it at the scalar level on every platform.

vello_common.why: vello_cpu's paths, strips and paints; feeds drawn pixels only.

glifo.why: vello_cpu's glyph outlines and caches; feeds drawn pixels only.

fearless_simd.why: vello_cpu's SIMD levels; deep-text forces its scalar fallback (force_support_fallback, Level::fallback) and it feeds drawn pixels only.

guillotiere.why: glifo's atlas allocator; integer rectangles only.

peniko.why: Brushes and font handles for vello; feeds drawn pixels only.

color.why: peniko's color spaces (its libm calls convert colors); feeds drawn pixels only.

kurbo.why: Curves and affine transforms for vello and glyph outlines; its libm calls feed drawn pixels only.

euclid.why: Geometry types under guillotiere and kurbo; feeds the atlas's placement and drawn pixels only.

polycool.why: Polynomial roots for kurbo's curve math; feeds drawn pixels only.

num-traits.why: Numeric traits euclid's geometry is generic over; feeds drawn pixels only.
